title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: Recognising the Transfer That Funded a Certificate
content:
Money that leaves a Savings & Money Market Accounts product to open a certificate of deposit shows on the savings ledger as an internal transfer out. This page defines which ledger entry is treated as the transfer that funded a certificate.

## Rule

**The latest internal transfer out.** Among the withdrawals on this account posted through the internal transfer channel, the one bearing the latest posting date is the candidate funding transfer.

**Alone on that date.** The candidate is accepted only if no other internal-transfer withdrawal shares its posting date. Where two or more posted that day, the ledger cannot say which came last, and no refund is made under this policy.

**Received by one of the customer's certificates.** The candidate is the funding transfer only if the account on its receiving side is a certificate of deposit that the Certificates of Deposit records list under the same customer; that certificate is the one the transfer funded. If the latest internal transfer went anywhere else, such as a checking account, no refund is made under this policy.

## Input, judgement, output

| Latest internal-transfer withdrawal(s) | Receiving account | Funding transfer identified? |
|---|---|---|
| one, posted 5 May | the customer's certificate of deposit | yes, the 5 May withdrawal |
| one, posted 5 May | the customer's Personal Checking account | no |
| two, both posted 5 May | a certificate and a checking account | no, the latest cannot be told apart |

## Hypothetical case

A Money Market Account sent 7500.00 by internal transfer to a new certificate of the owner on 12 February, and nothing by internal transfer since. That 12 February withdrawal is the funding transfer, and the certificate on its receiving side is the certificate it funded.

## Points of judgement

**An older internal transfer went to a certificate, but the latest went to checking. Is the older one used?** No. Only the latest internal transfer out is considered, and it did not go to a certificate.
